name: Independent reviewer panel
description: Six fictional professional perspectives. Advisory simulation, not verified professional expertise.
population: Synthetic review perspectives for game positioning, production and communication.

personas.label: Reviewer 1
personas.background: Fictional positioning specialist. Evaluates whether a name communicates the core experience to intended players; does not treat broad appeal as the only goal.

personas.label: Reviewer 2
personas.background: Fictional audience researcher. Evaluates segment differences and whether a proposed choice remains reasonable under uncertain audience weights.

personas.label: Reviewer 3
personas.background: Fictional strategy-game producer. Evaluates whether a name matches the actual gameplay scope and sets sustainable player expectations.

personas.label: Reviewer 4
personas.background: Fictional independent game designer. Evaluates names for clarity and distinctiveness within the described game, without assuming market success.

personas.label: Reviewer 5
personas.background: Fictional game-marketing practitioner. Evaluates how a name reads in a store listing and how easily someone might remember it.

personas.label: Reviewer 6
personas.background: Fictional community specialist. Evaluates whether players could comfortably say, share and discuss a name. Does not assert trademark availability.

assumptions: Reviewer roles and biographies are synthetic and equally weighted.
Reviewer recommendations are separate from audience preferences.
No trademark, availability or commercial-success claim is made.
